verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a developer platform with APIs, 'extensions and development kits', sandbox environment, and an official open-source CLI (rippling-cli) for building/deploying integrations, which supports SDK-style programmatic access. However, there's no explicit enumeration of language-specific SDKs (Python/JS/etc.) or independent hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality. Missing for 10: named official SDK packages/libraries, independent developer reviews or examples of SDK usage, broader language coverage beyond the CLI.
